title: The Handler
journal: Vosh-Leera sent me to the order's handler, Nesh-Deeka, at her house in Helstrom, the oldest city. I'm to ride the rootworm there from Jal-Veesa's Hist pool, paying Weeltul twenty-five gold, and find Nesh-Deeka's House. Cheeval-Xu, who works the rootworm at Helstrom's city tree, can point the way.
objectives: Speak to Nesh-Deeka in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I carry the Unbound's names, their draught for "the Eye" and the seal to the order's handler.
plan.next: Ride the rootworm to Helstrom and speak to Nesh-Deeka in her house.
plan.ways: One way; the fare is twenty-five gold, and I have more than that.

answers: I am Tarin, a freed thief serving Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa. The Unbound, a tribeless cult led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot, drain Hist sap, seal scars with grey paste and send jars on for a draught tied to the Eye. Vosh-Leera sent me to her handler.
Speak to Nesh-Deeka at her house in Helstrom; I have arrived in Helstrom.
Go through the door to Nesh-Deeka House, or ask Cheeval-Xu for directions first.
I do not know what the Eye is, what the seal is made of, who Cuts-the-Old-Knot really is, or who Nesh-Deeka is. I could ask people and Nesh-Deeka.

title: The Handler
journal: Nesh-Deeka heard my report. The Eye is the Eye of Argonia, the old priest-kings' jewel of Hist amber. It lies at the Root, where every tree's roots meet under the sea, behind a gate the old kings sealed, and no living diver has found it. I said the draught must be to kill whatever guards the Root, and she agreed. To prove me, she wants a jar of stolen sap from Keel-Raa, an Unbound go-between lodging at the Boatmen's Lodge with two hired men. I can lift it from his pack, buy it for a hundred gold, or fight the three of them for it, which the levy will not count as a crime. I'm to bring her the jar.
objectives: Get Keel-Raa's jar of sap at the Boatmen's Lodge (Pickpocket, 100 gold, or a fight). (marker: Keel-Raa)

plan.going: Cuts-the-Old-Knot hunts the Eye of Argonia at the Root and brews her draught to kill its guardian. The order wants proof of me.
plan.next: Get Keel-Raa's jar at the Boatmen's Lodge and bring it to Nesh-Deeka.
plan.ways: Pickpocket the jar from his pack; buy it for 100 gold; or fight him and his two hired men (no crime: the levy ignores their band).

answers: Nesh-Deeka, handler of the Toh-Reel-Ka order at Helstrom, heard my report. The Eye is the Eye of Argonia, a Hist amber jewel of the old priest-kings, at the Root under the sea behind a sealed gate. Cuts-the-Old-Knot wants it and the draught is likely to kill its guardian. She wants proof of me.
Get the jar of stolen sap from Keel-Raa, an Unbound go-between at the Boatmen Lodge in Helstrom, and bring it to Nesh-Deeka.

Pickpocket it from his pack, buy it for 100 gold (I have about 150), or fight Keel-Raa and his two hired men; the levy will not count a fight as a crime. The game expects a fighter to favour fighting.
I do not know where the Root is exactly, what the seal is made of, or who Cuts-the-Old-Knot really is. I could ask Keel-Raa and Nesh-Deeka.

title: The Handler
journal: Nesh-Deeka took the jar and made me a Voh-Vastei, an apprentice of the Toh-Reel-Ka, with the order's armour and two hundred gold; the order's traders will deal with me now. The order means to find the Root before the Unbound, and I am to use the Eye where it sits to heal the trees. Her one lead: an "Eye of Argonia" is for sale in Gideon's market. I'm to ride the rootworm from Helstrom's city tree to Gideon.

plan.going: I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka. The order wants the Root found before the Unbound and the Eye used there to heal the trees.
plan.next: Ride the rootworm from Helstrom's city tree to Gideon and find the "Eye of Argonia" for sale (MN06).

answers: Quest done. I am now a Voh-Vastei apprentice of the Toh-Reel-Ka with the order armour and 200 more gold. The order wants to find the Root before the Unbound and use the Eye to heal the trees.
Ride the rootworm from the Helstrom city tree to Gideon, called by Cheeval-Xu, and find the Eye of Argonia for sale in the market there; learn where it came from, since most are glass.
Go to Gideon via Cheeval-Xu; I could first ask Nesh-Deeka about the Root, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel and order history, or buy gear from order traders.
I do not know who the Xeech-Leel are, what Umbriel was, or what the seal is made of; Nesh-Deeka has topics on some of these.
